# Mentawai Roots
> Authentic Mentawai Tribe Tours & Cultural Trekking

Mentawai Roots offers regenerative eco-cultural and surf expeditions connecting travelers directly with indigenous Mentawai communities in West Sumatra, Indonesia.

## Key Expeditions
- Cultural Exploration & Tribal Immersion
- Siberut Jungle Trekking
- Sikerei Tattoo & Culture
- Surf Charters & Private Eco-Villas
